who's lara?.bio: who's lara? is a Montréal-based artist and producer working in the overlap between R&B and hip-hop. His catalogue includes the 2025 album Blur? and 2026 singles including Withdrawals, Want You and srx, with production playing a central role in his own recordings.

krys kofi.bio: Krys Kofi is a Cameroonian artist based in France whose music moves between R&B, rap and Afrobeats. He handles recording, mixing and mastering across his work, and followed his earlier The Playtime Is Over project with a run of 2026 releases including You got and the SENSUAL KOFI project.

gliiico.bio: Gliiico is a three-brother band made up of Kio, Kai and Nico de Torres. The group has Vancouver roots and is based in Tokyo, drawing on rock, pop and electronic influences; its 2026 album The Veil includes the single Don't Eat Don't Sleep.

aviv.bio: AVIV is a Toronto artist whose independent catalogue moves through alternative pop and singer-songwriter territory. In 2026, she surfaced new material including Mind Candy alongside demos and works in progress shared through her official SoundCloud.

raccoon.bio: Raccoon is a Montréal rapper whose catalogue includes the albums Gentil pour un noir, Le set up and C00N: la prophétie. In 2026 he joined ANJXLXE on Rêve un peu, a pop and R&B-leaning single produced by Da-P that pairs her melodic lead with Raccoon's verse.

faiza.bio: Faiza is a recording artist whose 2026 release These Days arrived in September. The current catalogue around the single also includes tracks such as Suddenly and Benchmark.

rosabell.bio: Rosabell is a Toronto-based Nigerian-Canadian singer-songwriter making pop and R&B centred on identity, self-discovery and emotional storytelling. Her three-song debut EP In Bloom includes Flowers, a bright, dance-leaning title track built around self-worth and learning to recognize your own growth.

cherrykim.bio: Cherrykim is a Montréal-based recording artist born in South Korea. His recent catalogue includes Can You Feel It?, everynight, Reach Out and the 2026 collaboration Breathe with Vancouver artist Luvinya.

black ken.bio: BLACK KEN is a recording artist whose 2026 single HOSTAGE is a collaboration with K. Forest. His official artist hub connects his releases across Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube, with HOSTAGE marking his latest appearance in Northern Dial rotation.

mulan.bio: Mulan is a Montréal R&B singer-songwriter. Her five-track debut project Angelic Crashout arrived in September 2026, moving between R&B and pop on songs including What Am I, Supermodel Boy, Butterfly and the title track.

zehd.bio: ZEHD is a francophone recording artist whose 2026 single copacabana was released through 3HZEHD. The track was written and performed by ZEHD with production and composition by Achel, following earlier releases including the Ctrl Zehd EP.

mouna tahar.bio: Mouna Tahar is an independent recording artist whose recent catalogue spans singer-songwriter material and collaborative work. Her 2025 and 2026 releases include Garden City, Out of Tune, Daisy (Please, Don't Break My Heart), Hope Is a Word I Used to Know and the 2026 single Cameraman.

ava ro.bio: Ava Ro is a pop recording artist who began releasing original music in 2025 and expanded her catalogue quickly in 2026. Her releases include Sevent33n, You Let Go, I Hate You But You're Mine and the six-song road trip EP, whose title track is in Northern Dial rotation.

deadin dogyears.bio: Deadin Dogyears is a hip-hop recording artist whose catalogue includes the 2024 album Dogyears, Vol. 1. The project has continued with 2026 releases including side_A // side_B and YUL//LGA.

ahsia.bio: AHSIA is a Philadelphia-born, Vancouver-raised singer, songwriter, producer, poet and educator. Her music blends R&B, soul, hip-hop and jazz while using sharp lyricism and humour to explore healing, identity and self-reclamation; her 2026 releases include RUNNIN and SO NICE.

monsune.bio: Monsune is the project of Toronto singer and producer Scott Zhang. Known for the 2019 EP Tradition and songs including OUTTA MY MIND and Mountain, he returned in August 2026 with Sure after a long stretch focused largely on production work.

colin léo.bio: Colin Léo is a Montréal singer-songwriter who combines hip-hop, pop and R&B with elements of Québec folk and alternative music. A 2026 Francouvertes participant, he released Mêmes habitudes in August, a song built around the repeating-cycle idea of a failing relationship.

frank.bio: frank is a Canadian independent artist whose 2026 releases include bike song, flynn rider, dirt and onions and your biggest fan. The latter was featured by CKMS-FM's Northern Lights program in a September 2026 episode dedicated to new Canadian music.

paradi$e.bio: Paradi$e is a Toronto R&B duo made up of producer Paul Tonks and vocalist Humberto Santos. After building an audience with R&B reinterpretations and original releases, the duo continued its run in 2026 with songs including SMS Love, Turn The Lights Down and Same Old Games.

6odem3.bio: 6ODEM3 is a francophone recording project built around Nolan Babin, Ulysse Leclerc and Carl-Aubert Langelier. The trio of writers and producers released W.I.P. and SEXES in 2026, with the latter issued in August through Disques Passeport under licence from 6ODEM3 Production.

karaba.bio: KARABA is a DJ, producer and former professional dancer born in Grenoble, France and raised in Montréal. Her music sits at the intersection of Afro house and underground club music, and her recent work includes the Tides remixes and 2026 singles such as Iya Yemoja, FOCUS, BIG DRIP and LMHYS.

olivia penalva.bio: Olivia Penalva is a Canadian pop singer-songwriter from Vernon, British Columbia, who began writing and releasing music at a young age. Her catalogue has produced multiple Canadian radio hits, and in 2026 she continued that run with Distance Makes a Love Story and Code Blue.

kayam.bio: KAYAM is a Canadian-born singer-songwriter from Calgary whose Tanzanian, Kenyan, Indian and British family background feeds a sound spanning pop, hip-hop, R&B and Afrobeats. His catalogue includes Paralyzed, Ride For Me and Your Soniya, while the 2026 single Singing In The Rain extends his contemporary R&B direction.

enola bedard.bio: Enola Bedard is a Canadian singer, dancer and choreographer from Québec City who is now based in Los Angeles. She writes and records her own music while directing the visual and performance side of her work, and her 2026 releases include GOGOYA, Unavez and the Rouge project.
